title: Strata coalescer for length-aware packing and adaptive pad trimming
author: Aisha Fernandez
description: Motivation: tail latency and token-cost regressions in workloads with high variance in sequence length were traced to suboptimal packing that either overpadded short sequences or left GPU slots underutilized for long sequences. This PR introduces a strata-based coalescer that groups incoming requests into dynamically computed length strata (percentile-driven) and then coalesces within and across adjacent strata to fill GPU slots while minimizing padding. The coalescer integrates with the continuous-batching pipeline and exposes runtime knobs for strata boundaries, spill thresholds, and kernel-alignment granularity. Key improvements: 1) Reduced mean padding tokens by ~18% on mixed web-chat benchmark and peak token cost by ~11% on internal 100k-sample trace. 2) Kernel alignment step biases coalescing to produce batch widths that match optimized kernel lane sizes (4/8/16), improving per-token throughput on A100 by 6-9% depending on model. 3) Lightweight KV-cache prefetch hints added to avoid cache misses when long sequences are coalesced with short prefixes that share KV rows. 4) Scheduler priority: latency-sensitive requests (tagged) are preferred to avoid added tail latency. 5) Extended test harness and perf regression CI to validate cost/latency tradeoffs. Implementation summary: the coalescer computes an adaptive histogram of incoming sequence lengths over a sliding window (default 5000 requests), derives strata boundaries at configurable percentiles (default p10,p25,p50,p75,p90), and maintains per-stratum queues. On slot allocation the algorithm pulls from the highest-fill strata first, then opportunistically draws from adjacent strata if doing so reduces expected pad cost without violating latency SLO. A spillover mechanism moves long requests that cannot be coalesced into dedicated slots to preserve latency. The PR also adds a small allocator to align resulting effective sequence widths to kernel-friendly multiples. The description below summarizes commits, files changed, review conversation, and perf numbers.

review_comments: Samir Patel: Nice approach; can you add a short doc on how to tune percentile boundaries for synthetic traffic? Request: make strata window size configurable at runtime.
Lena Kowalski: CI showed intermittent failure under ASan on macOS runner. Likely a use-after-free in slot_allocator when spill triggers. Please add sanitizer repro and fix.
Diego Ramos: Please add microbenchmarks comparing kernel-aligned vs non-aligned packing and include absolute p50/p99 token latency numbers for rtd2-small and rtd2-medium.

Aisha Fernandez (author): Addressed window size config, added runtime flag --strata-window and documented defaults; fixed ASan use-after-free by stabilizing stratum queue lifetime; added microbenchmarks to perf harness and uploaded numbers to docs.
Samir Patel: Approved after tweaks and unit test additions. Leaving minor nit on variable naming which author addressed.
Lena Kowalski: Re-ran CI after ASan fix, green. Approved.
Diego Ramos: Verified perf numbers on A100 and approved.
release_notes: Introduces a strata coalescer to reduce padding overhead and improve throughput for variable-length workloads. New runtime flags: --strata-window, --strata-percentiles, --kernel-align-multiple. Backwards-compatible defaults; enable via config in pipeline. Recommended for mixed-length conversational and batch-API traffic.
benchmark_summary: Mixed-web-chat (100k traces): padding tokens -18% mean, token cost -11% mean; A100 rtd2-small: throughput +7% with kernel alignment; tail latency p99 unchanged for tagged low-latency traffic; KV-prefetch reduced cache-miss spikes on long-coalesced batches.
notes_on_backwards_compatibility: Default behavior is off for dedicated legacy clusters; enabling requires a one-line config change. Existing metrics remain unchanged; added new metrics strata_count and strata_pad_tokens.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for strata boundaries and spill behavior; added stress test that simulates heavy variance in seq-lens; perf CI includes end-to-end reproducible harness. Flaky test fixed by increasing test harness timeouts.
